primary.title: US-Iran war: Defence funds surge, IT lags; experts share what mutual fund investors should do
primary.summary: Since the start of the US-Iran war in February, the Nifty Defence Index has delivered positive returns of 18.7%, while the Nifty IT Index declined 12.5%. Experts advise investors to avoid short-term reactions, focus on diversified funds, and use SIP investments during periods of market volatility.
